name: Sweet corn

schedule.notes: Plant in blocks of at least 4 rows for pollination. Soil must be 60+ F.
Nitrogen at knee-high; again at tasseling.
Silks brown and dry; kernel milk comes out cloudy when punctured with a thumbnail.

harvest.cues: Pull back husk slightly; kernels should be plump, full to the tip, milky when pierced.
harvest.storageNotes: Eat within hours of picking for peak sugar. Refrigerate husks-on max 1–2 days.

varieties.name: Bodacious
varieties.notes: Sugar-enhanced yellow. Holds sugar a few days after picking.

notes: Plant in dense square blocks, not long single rows — wind pollinates best with neighbors close by. Three Sisters: pair with pole bean (climbs corn) and winter squash (mulches the ground).
